info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Cross Channel By Param1-spec
info.description: The Cross Channel Management API facilitates the updating of interactive help configurations across various banking channels. Designed for financial institutions, this API allows users to modify settings associated with specific cross-channel interactions using a unique identifier (param1). Typical consumers include banking application developers and IT teams managing customer support interfaces. Through this API, organizations can ensure a consistent and helpful customer experience across all channels.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the specified interactive help resource. You can modify attributes such as title, content, and status to ensure the information is current and accurate for users.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the interactive help resource identified by RES-100045. The JSON payload should conform to the specified schema and include all necessary fields to correctly apply the changes. Ensure that all data is valid and complete to avoid errors during processing.

200.description: The request was successful and the resource has been updated.
